sourceChecks.text: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ヨシュアは、主がアブラハムを導き、その子孫を増やし、イサクを与えたと振り返ります。

sourceChecks.text: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 続く節で、主がイサクにヤコブとエサウを与えたと述べられます。

wikipediaArticleRead.title: Isaac
wikipediaArticleRead.noteJa: 記事はアブラハムの子イサクを扱い、ヨシュア記24:3–4の文脈と一致。
